# T-1: Add final-regression skip planning

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Introduce final-regression decision logic for same-flow full regression reuse and fail-closed risk-based skip.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Covered-by-test-execute skip requires full/pass v2 test-execute evidence, exact command identity equality by the R1 comparison rules, and exactly matching trigger-relevant changed-file fingerprints.
- Risk-based skip is allowed only for explicit non-runtime allowlist classifications, with generic test-only files requiring exact same-flow path-plus-fingerprint test-execute coverage.
- All stale, runtime-sensitive, config-sensitive, runner, dependency, external integration, and unknown changes run full regression.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer reusing `classifyRegression`, `discoverRegressionCommand`, and `listRegressionChangedFiles`; introduce dedicated classes for skip decisions or artifacts if invariants are non-trivial.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for covered-by-test-execute skip, stale command/source, stale changed files, non-runtime skip, and unknown/runtime full-run fallback.
